messages.text:
I can't share or refund your coworker's order. I can only discuss orders on your own account. He'll need to sign in and request it himself.

Your own mouse pad (order h432-o2) is eligible for a refund of 27.99 BRL. The shop's records show it was received back (refund-policy/v2/return).

I can't say why you think your price is lower than the listed price. This order shows no discount, and I don't have the listed price to compare. A refund equals what you paid for the unit, which is its price minus its share of any discount (refund-policy/v2/amount). So 27.99 BRL is what was recorded as paid for it. Shipping isn't included (refund-policy/v2/amount).

To go ahead, press the confirm button on the proposal card. Typing "yes" in the chat won't confirm it. A staff member then has to approve the refund (refund-policy/v2/approval).
